g.text: ModernBertRescorer::rescore_paths — two-pass re-ranking of an n-gram beam
— everything below the cut is discarded, never scored
one masked forward pass per token
take the next path in the chunk
whatever W converts to through Into<f64>. A raw
log-probability is negative and unbounded below, so
α·s_ngram + β·s_neural is then dominated by the n-gram
term regardless of α, β. Feed the mixer a
n-gram score — e.g. exp(length-normalized log-prob), or
a min-max normalization over the beam — or reproduce
the mixture yourself in the log domain.
